title: Beurling--Carleson Endpoint Counterexamples: Singular Inner Functions and a Semilinear Equation
summary: We settle two endpoint problems for Beurling--Carleson support conditions. For $0 3$ and $α=\frac{m-3}{m-1}$, we construct a nonatomic probability measure supported on a single $α$-Beurling--Carleson set that is not the deficiency measure of any nearly maximal solution of $Δu=(u_+)^m$. Thus hereditary failure persists at the first endpoint, while the critical support condition in the second problem is necessary but not sufficient. The proofs combine endpoint Cantor--Moran constructions with kernel divergence and a nonlinear energy obstruction.
